commentary: Two mythologies no studio could ever put in one film — **one person did it anyway**, with AI

credit.name: @evolving.ai
credit.note: original creator unnamed in the source; no mentions on the post

caption:
Chinese mythology against a Norse world-ender, in one battle.

The Four Symbols — Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, Qilin — plus the Nine-Tailed Fox, against Níðhöggr, the dragon that gnaws at the roots of the world tree.

Why this one matters past the spectacle: it could not be made the normal way. Not because of budget — because of clearance. Two mythologies, two studios' worth of rights, a nine-figure VFX bill. It dies in development every time.

One person made it anyway.

That's the actual shift, and it isn't "AI makes video". It's that the projects nobody was ever going to greenlight now get made.

Clip via @evolving.ai — the original creator isn't named in the source and the post tags nobody. If you know who made it, tag them and I'll credit properly.

What would you make if nobody had to approve it?
